description: Source code for the 'peer' component in the 'rafthttp' package of etcd, implementing peer-to-peer communication for Raft consensus, including message sending, snapshot transfer, connection management, and peer lifecycle control.

classes.name: peer
classes.description: Represents a remote Raft node, managing message streams, pipelines, snapshot sending, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: startPeer
methods.description: Initializes and starts a new peer instance with connection management and message processing routines.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a Raft message to the remote peer, non-blocking, with buffer handling.

methods.name: sendSnap
methods.description: Sends a snapshot message to the peer asynchronously.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the peer with new URLs.

methods.name: attachOutgoingConn
methods.description: Attaches an outgoing connection to the peer for streaming.

methods.name: activeSince
methods.description: Returns the time since the connection with the peer became active.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses the peer, dropping incoming messages.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Terminates the peer, closing connections and stopping routines.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Selects the appropriate channel for sending a message based on its type.
